newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU flour refund still five Ecus after tender.
newsitem.headline: EU flour refund still five Ecus after tender.

text.p: The European Union left its export refund for the leading class of wheat flour at five Ecus per tonne at a grain tender on Thursday, EU officials said.
Flour firms have complained the subsidy is too low to satisfy export requirements for the end of the season, but say talks have been set for mid-April in Brussels to review the industry's needs.
French cereals office ONIC said, however, that licence export validity had been limited to the end of June.
Millers aim to negotiate a special stop-gap refund for July until the new wheat crop arrives.
